Composer turns stream end-to-end through queue.ts effects into reasonChat.ts prompt() (:137), which invokes reason_open_chat (:152) and reason_prompt (:163); both are registered in lib.rs at :321-322 (all 96 invoke names in src/ are registered). #303 now sends sendReason through the queue (submitChat :201). #271 is still open: configureReason (:213) is only called from ReviewButton.tsx:74, so the main chat opens with config [] and the createFlow firstSession model and effort are dropped. #272 is still open too: the transcript and queue are only the in-memory chats Map (reasonChat.ts:57), only the Session id goes to localStorage (:83), the src-tauri/src/chat module (model.rs) is still not declared in lib.rs (only `pub mod agent` and `pub mod db`), and no command writes sessions or session_messages. The chat is still Reason-only; Claude Code and Codex have no command. Re-read at 1cedef0: #310 adds a Claude Code chat backend (claude_chat: claude_open_chat, claude_prompt, claude_cancel, claude_cli_path registered at lib.rs:331-335), but no file in src/ invokes any of them, so the app's chat is still Reason-only. reason_chat.rs is unchanged, so #271 and #272 stay open.
chat.session-stream.obligation: #271: pass the selected agent, model and effort for the main chat (configureReason from firstSession and the default model before the first prompt, plus set_config_option on a live Session). #272: persist sessions and session_messages (full_message, turn_id, cancelled_at) and reload them on reopen. Add a registered Claude Code / Codex runner.

The reference chat--transcript-collapsed-tools shows inline code chips and lists.
chat.markdown.obligation: Render assistant text blocks as markdown with inline code, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks.

chat.tool-calls.obligation: Group consecutive tool calls and intermediate text under one collapsible 'N tool calls, M messages' header, and add the keep-expanded setting wired to expandToolsByDefault.

chat.composer-send.why: Improved. The new Composer.tsx (mounted at WorkspaceView.tsx:176) reads chat.submitMessage, chat.submitOppositeFollowUp, chat.newLine and chat.cancel from effectiveShortcuts (:33, :52-67), so SEND_KEY_PRESETS and user overrides now apply. The hint and the Send/Queue/Steer label follow the mode (:83, :102). Still missing: no model chip, attach button or '⌘L to focus' hint. The model and effort still never reach the main chat (#271). Re-read at 1cedef0: unchanged; the composer still sends only through reason_prompt.
chat.composer-send.obligation: Add the send-key and follow-up-behavior settings and pass followUpMode into Composer. Add the composer model chip/picker wired to the Session model and effort (#271), the attach button and the focus hint.

chat.queue.why: New in #303: queue.ts (submit :89, drain :77, turnEnded :108, where a failed turn pauses a non-empty queue, pause/resume :121-128, saveEdit/steerQueued :148/:184, move/reorder) is run by reasonChat.ts setQueue/run (:99-121). Gaps: the queue lives only in the in-memory Chat (reasonChat.ts:46), and nothing writes queue_order or queue_paused_at, so it is lost on restart. Reorder is buttons, not drag. The chat.queue.* and chat.queueEdit.* keybindings (registry.ts:30) still have no handlers; the edit textarea hard-codes Enter and Escape (Composer.tsx:168-173).
chat.queue.obligation: Persist the queue (session_messages.queue_order, sessions.queue_paused_at) and restore it on reopen. Add drag reorder. Bind the chat.queue.* / chat.queueEdit.* keybindings instead of the hard-coded keys.

A Stop that arrives before the prompt is sent is no longer lost: the frontend holds unsent/stopped turns (reasonChat.ts:116, :148-156, cancelUnsent reason.ts:124), and the backend gets an expect_prompt ticket before the start checkpoint (reason_chat.rs:148, provider.rs:191, :236, :292). closeTurn marks the prompt cancelledAt (reason.ts:156). chat.cancel.obligation: Render the cancelled-message state ('Interrupted by user' badge driven by cancelledAt) and persist session_messages.cancelled_at. Wire Stop to the Claude Code and Codex runners once they exist.

chat.attachments.why: Unchanged apart from plumbing. The only sources are still the discard revert note (WorkspaceView.tsx:436) and the review prompt. draftAttachmentsApi is still imported by nothing, and there is no attach button, ⌘U (chat.addAttachment), file/image/paste/drag input, or attachments.is_draft write. chat.attachments.obligation: Mount draft attachments in the composer (attach button, ⌘U, drag/paste of files, images and terminal output) on draftAttachmentsApi, and materialize them on send with draft_attachments_materialize / materialize_local_path_attachment, recording attachments.is_draft. Show them as chips on sent messages.

Re-read at 1cedef0: #285 adds settings::launch (claude_launch/codex_launch map models.default/models.review and effort to CLI args), tested but called only from launch_tests.rs. chat.model-picker.obligation: Add the composer model picker with favorites and per-session effort, persisted to sessions (claude_effort_level, codex_thinking_level), and pass the model and effort into the agent launch.

chat.plan-mode.obligation: Add a plan-mode toggle to the composer (Shift+Tab), pass it to the agent launch, and show the plan review/approve step in the transcript.

diff.comments-github.why: #298 adds pr/review_comments.rs, which pages reviewThreads and PR comments over gh graphql, maps them in sync_set, extracts suggestion_base_code and resolves threads with the resolveReviewThread mutation. Sync also runs on a timer rather than inside the PR fetch, and PR-level comments only appear above an open file.

Add 'Add all GitHub comments to chat' and the resolve success/failure messages, store the old side as the reference's 'original' (or read both), and show PR-level comments without needing a file open.

pr.stack.obligation: Model dependent PR stacks (fetch stack fields), show the stack view, and implement merge-stack with its failure state.
